purpose: Functional release screening, not full PVT/mismatch or extracted-metal qualification
sampling_note: Waveform screen cases are nominal full transistor arrays. Large storage probes sample unselected cells and include every selected-row cell. No yield or full PVT qualification is claimed.
small_source_note: Small screen precedes the parser-only duplicate-column repair; circuit generation and independent scoring are unchanged. Both queue snapshots are preserved.

guard_diagnostics.scope: Completed isolated transistor-control diagnostics only, not full-array qualification. The preexisting full-array write failure remains rejected until rerun.

reports.name: 8x512_FF_1.1V_-40C
reports.note: Actual PRE buffer, wire and precharge/local-RC gate loads. BL/BLB tied to VDD, valid while access waits; no SRAM cells. Six guard variants each add a 0.5-unit observation load (2.5 more units than production), conservatively increasing the far-PRE load. Raw request is a clock-like pulse. Not qualification.

selected_design.settling_formula: tau = cols * wire_R_per_pitch * (pre_load * 0.5e-15 + cols * wire_C_per_pitch) + (pi_res * pi_cap if local_RC else 0)
selected_design.note: Delay-chain input MOS capacitance adds conservative delay beyond explicit R*C. Tau is immutable baseline metadata; no PVT or candidate calibration.

guard_diagnostics_note: Isolated precharge/control networks establish design margins; they are not SRAM qualification. Final full-array cases are listed separately.
